verdict.rationale: Sentry offers AI agent tracing, dashboards, conversation replay and an official CLI. Nothing in the evidence describes running evals or scoring datasets, in CI or anywhere else, or gating deployments on eval results. Comparing models and prompts in the LLM Calls view is production observability, not CI evaluation, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As a developer, I can run evals in CI and gate deployments on their results
